# mapbox usage

1 command. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox usage

Show account/token usage by product and day (Statistics API)

Show usage per Mapbox product, by day, for the account or one token.

Calls the Statistics API; the token needs the `statistics:read` scope. `mapbox auth login` requests it by default; log in again if your stored token predates that.

See https://github.com/mapbox/cli/issues.

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `daily` | `--daily` | no | boolean |  | List each product's usage day by day instead of a sparkline. Only changes -o text; -o json always has the daily figures. |
| `period-end` | `--period-end PERIOD_END` | no | string |  | End of the usage period, inclusive. Defaults to today. At most 31 days after --period-start. |
| `period-start` | `--period-start PERIOD_START` | no | string |  | Start of the usage period, inclusive. Defaults to 30 days ago. |
| `product` | `--product PRODUCT` | no | string |  | Only show this product. |
| `token-id` | `--token-id TOKEN_ID` | no | string |  | Usage for one token instead of the whole account. See `mapbox accounts list-tokens` for ids. |

```sh
mapbox usage
```
